#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
long long even, odd;
unordered_map<long long, pair<long long, long long>> pairMemo;

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long b) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

pair<long long, long long> getPair(long long n) {
    auto it = pairMemo.find(n);
    if (it != pairMemo.end()) return it->second;
    pair<long long, long long> ans;
    if (n == 1) {
        ans = {even, odd};
    } else if (n == 2) {
        long long e = (even * even + odd * odd) % MOD;
        long long o = (even * odd + odd * even) % MOD;
        ans = {e, o};
    } else {
        auto left = getPair(n / 2);
        auto right = getPair(n - n / 2);
        long long e = (left.first * right.first + left.second * right.second) % MOD;
        long long o = (left.first * right.second + left.second * right.first) % MOD;
        ans = {e, o};
    }
    pairMemo[n] = ans;
    return ans;
}

void solve() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long sz = n * m;
    if (sz % 2 == 0) {
        even = (r - l + 1) / 2;
        if ((r - l) % 2 == 0 && l % 2 == 0) {
            even++;
        }
        odd = r - l + 1 - even;
        cout << getPair(sz).first << endl;
    } else {
        cout << pow_mod(r - l + 1, sz) << endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
